# Generated by bubble_ex from a Bubble app's data model. Deterministic:
# the same model and name map give the same file.
#
# One file holds many modules; split them one per file in your project
# (lib/my_app/task.ex, ...). The repo is referenced but not generated:
#   mix igniter.new my_app --install ash,ash_postgres
# then add these modules and run `mix ash.codegen --dev` while iterating.

defmodule MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead do
  @moduledoc """
  Policy check: an authorized read (or aggregate) of the primary `:read`
  must select records by primary key (`Ash.get`) or load them through a
  relationship; direct view in Bubble reaches a record through a
  reference, never by listing. Otherwise it is forbidden. Enumerate
  and count with `:search`.
  Generated by bubble_ex (WTF-356); enforced (privacy: :enforced), checked by the privacy matrix, not proved.
  """
  use Ash.Policy.SimpleCheck

  alias Ash.Query.{BooleanExpression, Ref}
  alias Ash.Query.Operator.{Eq, In}

  @impl true
  def describe(_opts), do: "the read selects records by primary key"

  # A policy check, not a preparation: it also sees aggregate queries
  # (count, exists, max, ...), which run no read hooks. A
  # relationship load (`accessing_from`) is keyed by the source
  # records' IDs, possibly as `id == parent(...)`.
  @impl true
  def match?(_actor, %{query: %Ash.Query{} = query}, _opts) do
    query.context[:accessing_from] != nil or
      keyed?(query.filter && query.filter.expression, query.resource)
  end

  def match?(_actor, _context, _opts), do: false

  defp keyed?(%BooleanExpression{op: :and, left: left, right: right}, resource),
    do: keyed?(left, resource) or keyed?(right, resource)

  defp keyed?(%Eq{left: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}, right: v}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(%Eq{left: v, right: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(%In{left: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}, right: v}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(_expression, _resource), do: false

  defp key?(attribute, resource),
    do: [name(attribute)] == Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(resource)

  defp name(%{name: name}), do: name
  defp name(name), do: name
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields do
  @moduledoc """
  Policy check (a filter): Bubble lets a privacy rule keep fields out of
  the searches of the users it applies to (non-filterable fields). A read
  (`:read`, `:search`) whose filter or sort names such a field, as
  client input (`filter_input`, `sort_input`) or in code, directly or
  as the first step of a relationship path, returns only the records
  where the actor may search by it; one naming a restricted field
  further along a relationship returns nothing. Aggregates over such a
  field (`Ash.max/3`, ...) are not covered: generated code must not
  aggregate it for users who may not search by it.
  With enforced policies, a field some users may not view (and a gated
  relationship) is restricted the same way: field policies do not
  guard a filter or sort written in code, so such a read returns only
  the records where the actor may view the field. Bubble matches the
  stored value for every user who may search by it; this is stricter
  by the owner's decision (BubbleEx.Verify.Difference,
  hidden_field_constraint_matches).
  Generated by bubble_ex; enforced (privacy: :enforced), checked by the privacy matrix, not proved.
  """
  use Ash.Policy.FilterCheck

  alias Ash.Query.{BooleanExpression, Exists, Not, Parent, Ref}

  # resource => field => groups: every group must hold, through one of
  # its privacy calculations (`:never`: no user may search by it).
  @restricted %{
    MyApp.Task => [

          :privacy_rule_eq_user,
          :privacy_rule_eq_yes,
          :privacy_rule_is_no,
          :privacy_rule_is_no_is_no,
          :privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived,
          :privacy_rule_is_yes,
          :privacy_rule_neq_field,
          :privacy_rule_neq_no,
          :privacy_rule_neq_yes,
          :privacy_rule_not_empty,
          :privacy_rule_user_is_no

      ],

        [

          :privacy_rule_eq_condition,
          :privacy_rule_eq_field,
          :privacy_rule_eq_no,
          :privacy_rule_eq_user,
          :privacy_rule_eq_yes,
          :privacy_rule_is_no,

        ]
      ],
      creator: [

        ]
      ],
      modified_date: [
        [
          :privacy_rule_bare,
          :privacy_rule_empty,
          :privacy_rule_eq_condition,
          :privacy_rule_eq_field,

        ]
      ],
      title: [
        [
          :privacy_rule_bare,
          :privacy_rule_empty,
          :privacy_rule_eq_condition,
          :privacy_rule_eq_field,
          :privacy_rule_eq_no,
          :privacy_rule_eq_user,
          :privacy_rule_eq_yes,
          :privacy_rule_is_no,
          :privacy_rule_is_no_is_no,
          :privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived,
          :privacy_rule_is_yes,
          :privacy_rule_neq_field,
          :privacy_rule_neq_no,
          :privacy_rule_neq_yes,
          :privacy_rule_not_empty,
          :privacy_rule_user_is_no
        ]
      ]
    ]
  }

  @impl true
  def describe(_opts),
    do: "the read names only fields the actor may search by, where it matters"

  @doc "The restricted fields of `resource`: `[{field, groups}]`."
  def restricted(resource), do: Map.get(@restricted, resource, [])

  @impl true
  def filter(_actor, %{query: %Ash.Query{} = query}, _opts) do
    stack = [{query.resource, true}]
    expression = query.filter && query.filter.expression
    names = sort_names(query, stack) ++ names(expression, stack)

    case grants(names) do
      :deny -> false
      [] -> true
      groups -> Enum.reduce(groups, true, fn calcs, acc -> expr(^acc and ^any(calcs)) end)
    end
  end

  def filter(_actor, _context, _opts), do: false

  defp any(calculations),
    do: Enum.reduce(calculations, false, fn calc, acc -> expr(^acc or ^ref(calc)) end)

  # The groups the named fields need; `:deny` when one is restricted and
  # not on the queried resource itself, or nobody may search by it.
  defp grants(names) do
    Enum.reduce_while(names, [], fn {resource, name, root?}, acc ->
      case Keyword.get(restricted(resource), name) do
        nil ->
          {:cont, acc}

        groups ->
          if root? and :never not in groups,
            do: {:cont, Enum.uniq(acc ++ groups)},
            else: {:halt, :deny}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp sort_names(query, stack) do
    (List.wrap(query.sort) ++ List.wrap(query.distinct_sort) ++ List.wrap(query.distinct))
    |> Enum.flat_map(fn
      {field, _direction} -> field_names(field, stack)
      field -> field_names(field, stack)
    end)
  end

  defp field_names(name, [{resource, root?} | _]) when is_atom(name),
    do: [{resource, name, root?}]

  defp field_names(field, stack), do: names(%Ref{attribute: field, relationship_path: []}, stack)

  # `{resource, field, root?}` for every field an expression names, with
  # each step of a relationship path; `stack` holds the resources of the
  # enclosing `exists`, innermost first (root?: the queried resource).
  defp names(%BooleanExpression{left: left, right: right}, stack),
    do: names(left, stack) ++ names(right, stack)

  defp names(%Not{expression: expression}, stack), do: names(expression, stack)

  # An unrelated `exists(Resource, ...)` reads another resource.
  defp names(%Exists{related?: false, resource: other, expr: expression}, stack),
    do: names(expression, [{other, false} | stack])

  defp names(
         %Exists{path: path, at_path: at_path, expr: expression},
         [{resource, root?} | _] = stack
       ) do
    full = (at_path || []) ++ path

    case Ash.Resource.Info.related(resource, full) do
      nil -> [{resource, :__unknown__, false}]
      related -> hops(resource, full, root?) ++ names(expression, [{related, false} | stack])
    end
  end

  # `parent(...)` reads the enclosing resource; at the top level (a
  # relationship's own filter) it is outside the read.
  defp names(%Parent{expr: expression}, [_ | [_ | _] = outer]), do: names(expression, outer)
  defp names(%Parent{}, _stack), do: []

  defp names(%Ref{relationship_path: path, attribute: attribute}, [{resource, root?} | _] = stack) do
    path = path || []

    case attribute do
      %Ash.Query.Calculation{calc_name: nil, opts: opts} ->
        related = Ash.Resource.Info.related(resource, path)

        hops(resource, path, root?) ++
          names(opts[:expr], [{related, root? and path == []} | stack])

      attribute ->
        hops(resource, path ++ [field_name(attribute)], root?)
    end
  end

  defp names(%Ash.CustomExpression{expression: expression}, stack), do: names(expression, stack)

  defp names(%{__operator__?: true, left: left, right: right}, stack),
    do: names(left, stack) ++ names(right, stack)

  defp names(%{__function__?: true, arguments: arguments}, stack), do: names(arguments, stack)
  defp names(%Ash.Query.Call{args: args}, stack), do: names(args, stack)
  # A fragment's arguments (keyword search): its expressions, not its SQL.
  defp names({tag, expression}, stack) when tag in [:expr, :casted_expr],
    do: names(expression, stack)

  defp names(list, stack) when is_list(list), do: Enum.flat_map(list, &names(&1, stack))
  defp names(_other, _stack), do: []

  defp hops(_resource, [], _root?), do: []
  defp hops(resource, [name], root?), do: [{resource, name, root?}]

  defp hops(resource, [name | rest], root?) do
    case Ash.Resource.Info.related(resource, [name]) do
      nil -> [{resource, name, root?}]
      related -> [{resource, name, root?} | hops(related, rest, false)]
    end
  end

  defp field_name(%Ash.Query.Calculation{calc_name: n}) when is_atom(n) and not is_nil(n), do: n
  defp field_name(%Ash.Query.Aggregate{agg_name: n}) when is_atom(n) and not is_nil(n), do: n
  defp field_name(%{name: name}) when is_atom(name), do: name
  defp field_name(name) when is_atom(name), do: name
  defp field_name(_other), do: :__unknown__
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite do
  @moduledoc """
  Policy check: the write is made by the generated workflow runtime,
  which marks its data steps with the context
  `%{private: %{bubble_workflow_write: true}}` (private context only:
  the same flag in `shared` context, which Ash copies into nested
  actions, does not count). As in Bubble, the workflow's
  own conditions are what guard its writes: they are not checked
  against the privacy rules. Any other write (owned code, a form, an
  API) is forbidden unless it bypasses authorization.
  Generated by bubble_ex (WTF-423).
  """
  use Ash.Policy.SimpleCheck

  @impl true
  def describe(_opts), do: "the generated workflow runtime makes the write"

  @impl true
  def match?(_actor, %{changeset: %{context: context}}, _opts), do: workflow_write?(context)
  def match?(_actor, %{subject: %{context: context}}, _opts), do: workflow_write?(context)
  def match?(_actor, _context, _opts), do: false

  defp workflow_write?(%{private: %{bubble_workflow_write: true}} = context),
    do: not shared?(Map.get(context, :shared))

  defp workflow_write?(_context), do: false

  # Ash merges `shared` context into the action's own (and into
  # every nested action's): a flag that came that way is refused.
  defp shared?(%{private: %{bubble_workflow_write: _}}), do: true
  defp shared?(_shared), do: false
end

defmodule MyApp.Task do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "task"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
      reference :creator_for_privacy, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :archived, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :done, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :title, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false

      filter expr(
               parent(
                 privacy_rule_bare or privacy_rule_empty or privacy_rule_eq_condition or
                   privacy_rule_eq_field or privacy_rule_eq_no or privacy_rule_eq_user or
                   privacy_rule_eq_yes or privacy_rule_is_no or privacy_rule_is_no_is_no or
                   privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived or privacy_rule_is_yes or privacy_rule_neq_field or
                   privacy_rule_neq_no or privacy_rule_neq_yes or privacy_rule_not_empty or
                   privacy_rule_user_is_no
               )
             )
    end

    belongs_to :creator_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_rule_bare, :boolean, expr(done == true),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"bare\" (bare_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_empty, :boolean, expr(is_nil(done)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"empty\" (empty_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_eq_condition,
              :boolean,
              expr(
                (done == true and (is_nil(title) or title == "")) or
                  (done == false and not (is_nil(title) or title == ""))
              ),
              public?: false,
              description:
                "Bubble privacy rule \"eq_condition\" (eq_condition_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_eq_field, :boolean, expr(is_not_distinct_from(done, archived)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"eq_field\" (eq_field_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_eq_no, :boolean, expr(done == false),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"eq_no\" (eq_no_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_eq_user, :boolean, expr(done == ^actor(:admin)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"eq_user\" (eq_user_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_eq_yes, :boolean, expr(done == true),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"eq_yes\" (eq_yes_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_is_no, :boolean, expr(done == false),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"is_no\" (is_no_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_is_no_is_no, :boolean, expr(is_not_distinct_from(done, true)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"is_no_is_no\" (is_no_is_no_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived, :boolean, expr(done == false or archived == true),
      public?: false,
      description:
        "Bubble privacy rule \"is_no_or_archived\" (is_no_or_archived_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_is_yes, :boolean, expr(done == true),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"is_yes\" (is_yes_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_neq_field,
              :boolean,
              expr(is_not_distinct_from(done, true) != is_not_distinct_from(archived, true)),
              public?: false,
              description: "Bubble privacy rule \"neq_field\" (neq_field_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_neq_no, :boolean, expr(is_not_distinct_from(done, true)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"neq_no\" (neq_no_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_neq_yes, :boolean, expr(is_distinct_from(done, true)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"neq_yes\" (neq_yes_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_not_empty, :boolean, expr(not is_nil(done)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"not_empty\" (not_empty_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_user_is_no, :boolean, expr(^actor(:admin) == false),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"user_is_no\" (user_is_no_): its condition holds"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356), ENFORCED
  # (privacy: :enforced, WTF-423). Reads follow the compiled rules, checked
  # by the privacy matrix against the calibrated reading of Bubble; where a
  # condition reads an empty value on the user's side (logged out, or a
  # user without the value) they deny what Bubble may grant (stricter by
  # design). WRITES ARE NOT CHECKED AGAINST THE PRIVACY RULES: a write the
  # generated workflow runtime makes is authorized (Privacy.WorkflowWrite:
  # the workflow's conditions guard it, as in Bubble); any other write is
  # forbidden. Fields a rule keeps out of the users' searches (Bubble's
  # non-filterable fields) are guarded by Privacy.SearchFields: a read
  # filtering or sorting on one returns only the records where the actor
  # may search by it. Fields some users may not view are guarded the same
  # way (WTF-457): a read whose filter or sort names one returns only the
  # records where the actor may view it (stricter than Bubble, which
  # matches the stored value). Load the actor with the Privacy module's
  # load_actor/1 on every request and LiveView mount. Enumerate records
  # only through :search; :read returns records by primary key. Field
  # policies do not guard a calculation written in code that reads a field
  # the actor may not view, nor do they cover aggregates: never aggregate
  # a field the actor may not view.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_bare)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_empty)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_condition)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_field)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_user)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no_is_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_field)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_not_empty)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_user_is_no)
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_bare)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_empty)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_condition)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_field)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_user)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no_is_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_field)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_not_empty)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_user_is_no)
    end

    policy action(:create) do
      description "Writes by the generated workflow runtime: the workflow's conditions guard them, as in Bubble (not checked against the privacy rules)"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite
    end

    policy action(:update) do
      description "Writes by the generated workflow runtime: the workflow's conditions guard them, as in Bubble (not checked against the privacy rules)"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite
    end

    policy action(:destroy) do
      description "Writes by the generated workflow runtime: the workflow's conditions guard them, as in Bubble (not checked against the privacy rules)"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "A filter or sort naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records where the actor may"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "A filter or sort naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records where the actor may"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :archived, :done, :title] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_bare)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_empty)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_condition)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_field)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_user)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_eq_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no_is_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_no_or_archived)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_is_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_field)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_no)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_neq_yes)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_not_empty)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_user_is_no)
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.User do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "user"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :email, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :confirmed_at, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: false
    attribute :admin, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
    end
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356), ENFORCED
  # (privacy: :enforced, WTF-423). Reads follow the compiled rules, checked
  # by the privacy matrix against the calibrated reading of Bubble; where a
  # condition reads an empty value on the user's side (logged out, or a
  # user without the value) they deny what Bubble may grant (stricter by
  # design). WRITES ARE NOT CHECKED AGAINST THE PRIVACY RULES: a write the
  # generated workflow runtime makes is authorized (Privacy.WorkflowWrite:
  # the workflow's conditions guard it, as in Bubble); any other write is
  # forbidden. Fields a rule keeps out of the users' searches (Bubble's
  # non-filterable fields) are guarded by Privacy.SearchFields: a read
  # filtering or sorting on one returns only the records where the actor
  # may search by it. Fields some users may not view are guarded the same
  # way (WTF-457): a read whose filter or sort names one returns only the
  # records where the actor may view it (stricter than Bubble, which
  # matches the stored value). Load the actor with the Privacy module's
  # load_actor/1 on every request and LiveView mount. Enumerate records
  # only through :search; :read returns records by primary key. Field
  # policies do not guard a calculation written in code that reads a field
  # the actor may not view, nor do they cover aggregates: never aggregate
  # a field the actor may not view.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy action(:create) do
      description "Writes by the generated workflow runtime: the workflow's conditions guard them, as in Bubble (not checked against the privacy rules)"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite
    end

    policy action(:update) do
      description "Writes by the generated workflow runtime: the workflow's conditions guard them, as in Bubble (not checked against the privacy rules)"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite
    end

    policy action(:destroy) do
      description "Writes by the generated workflow runtime: the workflow's conditions guard them, as in Bubble (not checked against the privacy rules)"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.WorkflowWrite
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :email, :admin] do
      authorize_if always()
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp do
  use Ash.Domain

  resources do
    resource MyApp.Task
    resource MyApp.User
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy do
  @moduledoc """
  Privacy rules compiled from Bubble to Ash policies by bubble_ex (WTF-356),
  ENFORCED (`privacy: :enforced`, WTF-423).

  Reads follow the compiled rules. They are checked by the privacy matrix
  against the calibrated reading of Bubble, not proved: `verified?/0` is
  false. Where a condition reads an empty value on the user's side (logged
  out, or a user without the value), the policies deny what Bubble may
  grant (stricter by design; verification lists each case).

  WRITES ARE NOT CHECKED AGAINST THE PRIVACY RULES. A write the generated
  workflow runtime makes is authorized (the `WorkflowWrite` check): the
  workflow's own conditions guard it, as in Bubble. Any other write is
  forbidden unless it bypasses authorization.
  """

  @doc "The privacy mode the policies were generated with: enforced (WTF-423)."
  def mode, do: :enforced

  @doc "Whether the generated policies are verified against Bubble: not yet."
  def verified?, do: false

  @doc "The relationships of the actor that the policies read."
  def actor_loads, do: []

  @doc "The resource of the actor (Bubble's User)."
  def actor_resource, do: MyApp.User

  @doc """
  Reads the actor (a user or a user ID) afresh with `actor_loads/0`,
  bypassing authorization: the policies must see its current values.
  Call it on every request and LiveView mount, never reuse a stored
  actor. Returns nil (logged out) for nil or an unknown ID.
  """
  def load_actor(nil), do: nil
  def load_actor(%{id: id}), do: load_actor(id)

  def load_actor(id) when is_binary(id) do
    # bubble:ignores_privacy scaffold:load_actor
    case Ash.get(MyApp.User, id, load: actor_loads(), authorize?: false) do
      {:ok, actor} -> actor
      {:error, _} -> nil
    end
  end
end
